description: This PHP class 'ChangeLogger' is an event subscriber for the Drupal package_manager module. It logs package installation, update, and removal events during the package stage lifecycle, including recording installed packages, requested package versions, and logging changes.

classes.name: ChangeLogger
classes.description: Final class implementing an event subscriber that logs package management lifecycle events in Drupal.

methods.name: recordInstalledPackages
methods.description: Records the list of installed packages at the start of the stage lifecycle.

methods.name: recordRequestedPackageVersions
methods.description: Records requested package versions during require operations and logs changes if in direct-write mode.

methods.name: logChanges
methods.description: Logs detailed changes in package versions, including updates, installations, and removals.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, mapping events to handler methods.
